trailhead.label: Brandis-Waalweg access just above the Gampen car park (P4) in Lana, the board’s start

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
About 170 m along the Gampen road (SS238) in Lana: keep your dog close on a short lead.
A short steep stretch of about 20 m above the parish church of Niederlana.
Orchards and vineyards beside the path are farmed land, closed to dogs in Lana in the growing season: keep to the path.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
